name: cawala-web
description: Cawala M0 web harness: Svelte 5 + Vite static app, wasm-bindgen client wired to the iroh relay

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm:release && vite build && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs
scripts.build:singlefile: npm run build:wasm:release && vite build --config vite.config.singlefile.js && node scripts/check-singlefile.mjs
